policy_presence.summary: Australian National University has established official generative AI guidance across coursework, academic integrity, and staff teaching resources.

ai_disclosure.summary: For ANU Law School submissions where AI tools are used, students must declare the application names, purpose, and extent/frequency; the declaration should be in the first footnote. For other ANU assessments, follow the course-specific instructions.

coursework.summary: Generative AI is not banned across ANU; whether AI is permitted depends entirely on course convenor instructions, class summaries, and assessment outlines.

exams.summary: Central invigilated examination rules regarding generative AI have not been established in the reviewed public evidence; convenor instructions apply.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Staff and students must not upload confidential ANU materials, assessment content, or personal information without consent to AI platforms.

academic_integrity.summary: Submitting AI-generated content as one's own breaches the Academic Integrity Rule 2021; outcomes are tiered into No Breach, Poor Academic Practice, or Academic Misconduct.

approved_tools.summary: Microsoft Copilot Enterprise (with Commercial Data Protection) is available to staff and students via SSO. Adobe Firefly is available for staff and specific creative cohorts.

named_ai_services.summary: Centrally supported enterprise tools include Microsoft Copilot Enterprise and Adobe Firefly with institutional data protection.

teaching_guidance.summary: ANU Centre for Learning & Teaching provides comprehensive resources on assessment design, authentic assessment, and AI literacy.

research_guidance.summary: Under Australian Research Council (ARC) policy cataloged by ANU Library, researchers applying for ARC grants must ensure the integrity and accuracy of applications and must disclose any use of generative AI. Under ACM publisher standards cataloged by ANU Library, AI tools cannot be listed as authors and AI-assisted content creation must be disclosed. These external requirements apply to their respective grant and publication contexts.

security_procurement.summary: Procurement and deployment of AI solutions must follow university cybersecurity, privacy, and IT architecture review processes.
